caveat: This snapshot reflects the page BEFORE any content change -- filterCity:'Paphos' with no property-type or stage filter, i.e. the page currently shows ALL published Paphos inventory (199 listings), not just off-plan stock, despite its name and URL. Any position/impression movement measured a month after narrowing could be caused by the content becoming more relevant to these queries, OR by ordinary rank drift unrelated to the change (this cluster's data has shown real day-to-day and week-to-week drift throughout this investigation, independent of any site change). Do not attribute 100% of any observed movement to the narrowing without checking whether OTHER cluster pages moved similarly over the same period as a control.
